global_history: Born from the Great Ignition, Syncline was hollowed out to feed a thousand-year war. Its tectonic plates were shackled with iron, turning magma veins into industrial arteries. For centuries, the clatter of massive pneumatic presses has replaced the sound of wind. Generations of soot-stained laborers live and die within the sulfurous heat of the Foundry Depths, their lives measured in tons of refined star-steel. It is a world of screaming steam and molten rivers, where the mechanical heart beats only to consume the weak and forge the eternal machinery of the void.

civilizations.name: The Iron-Sunder Cartel
civilizations.summary: A civilization forged in the crushing pressures of Syncline, the Iron-Sunder Cartel is a society defined by industrial dominance and physical endurance. They utilize massive tectonic drills and magma-fueled foundries to extract rare minerals from the planet's core, viewing the harsh heat not as a threat, but as a source of absolute power. Their culture revolves around the 'Great Tempering,' the belief that only that which can survive the furnace is worthy of existence.

civilizations.name: The Argent-Forge Hegemony
civilizations.summary: A civilization of master artisans and kinetic engineers who thrive in the high-heat, high-pressure tunnels of Syncline. They have evolved a culture centered on extreme manual dexterity and rhythmic precision, viewing the constant motion of the foundries as a sacred dance. Their society is organized into guilds that maintain the massive atmospheric heat-exchangers and automated assembly lines that keep the subterranean atmosphere breathable.

civilizations.name: The Arch-Engineers of Syncline
civilizations.summary: A highly logic-driven civilization of heat-scientists and master smiths who have harnessed the volcanic instability of their world through massive geothermal conduits and precision metalworks. They view the flow of magma as a predictable variable in a grand thermodynamic equation, building a society around the optimization of resource extraction and the refinement of exotic alloys.
